posts.title: Retention School launch

copy.default:
I think more useful business education should be free.

A lot of what I’ve learnt about retention, lifecycle, CRM, deliverability and revenue recovery came from people who taught generously before asking for anything in return.

I want 222Emails to do more of that too.

So I’m building Retention School.

It’ll be a free education initiative from 222Emails focused on practical lessons, breakdowns, resources and real-world insights around retention, lifecycle systems, CRM, deliverability, revenue recovery, testing and measurement.

The goal is simple: make useful retention education easier to access, easier to follow and more valuable over time.

Not more content.

Something genuinely useful.

Retention School by 222Emails.
